whatsappMessage:
Hi Fitness Icon Team,

I noticed your gym has stellar 4.9★ reviews from over 700 members in Musallahpur Hat, but currently lacks a dedicated mobile website for online membership inquiries.

Maine aapke gym ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, workout programs, aur batch timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://fitnessicon.arclanestudios.space

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript:
"Hi Fitness Icon Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke gym ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. 

Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya?

Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp trial booking, mobile-first speed, and showcasing your 4.9-star reputation right in Musallahpur Hat, Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?

Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
